page.overview:
Who is Becky Duvall?

Unnamed father-in-law † Scott Duvall (husband) Jack Duvall † (son) Jessica Duvall † (sister-in-law) Gretchen Duvall † (niece)

Becky Duvall was a supporting antagonist in the third season of the series and had debuted in the sixth episode.

She was the wife of Scott Duvall, and the mother of their son Jack Duvall. Following the deaths of Scott's sister and niece, Becky fostered a profound sense of animosity in Scott and helped him in his vengeful crusade against Invincible. She and Jack were ultimately killed accidentally by Scott during their plan to draw out and face Invincible.

Becky is a slim yet curvy woman with shoulder-length black hair, dark blue eyes, full lips, and pale skin. She also has bags under her eyes, seemingly from her constant dismay at her sister-in-law's death and her hatred of Invincible.
